result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. However, it unnecessarily extends the obligation beyond Company data to all Works and Confidential Information, potentially affecting existing payment-conditioned rights concerning Works and requiring machine-readable return and deletion of materials for which that treatment may be inappropriate. It also creates a duplicate subsection (c).
